g.text: config_version : int -- CHECK >= 1; bumped on re-registration
run_id : varchar -- last sync that changed the row
fingerprint : varchar -- pulled set; identical pull = no-op
planned, completed, failed, skipped, queued : int
item_key : varchar -- permit number or question id
key : varchar «PK» -- sha256(question, jurisdiction, versions, model, day)
expires_at : timestamp -- 24h TTL; pruned by pts db prune
replaced_by : varchar -- e.g. pts seeds seattle
created_at : timestamp -- when it was replaced
On delete: permits, sync_metadata, status_history, detail_snapshots,
skill_inferences and eval_results CASCADE from their parent;
(the run ledger) CASCADE; detail_fetch_results.snapshot_id is SET NULL.
nlu_cache (Stage 04, migration 0003) has no foreign keys.
run_id joins pipeline_runs.run_id for worker runs, no FK),
Stage 08 (migration 0009): labels (permit_id and superseded_by SET NULL;
one current row per kind/item/role/labeler), build_gates (no FK),
Full column list: the ORM models in discovery/registry.py.
